t:
Arggh! You defeated strong spirit... You brave warrior!
You talk about great victory and pain from past. Me understand. You not understand!
We fight against worms-on-face long ago. You want peace. How we can be peace? Worms-on-face killed our fathers. They fight! We can't be peace.
Me will think. Me say truth. There can be no two truths.
You leave. Me think.

Meatbag. Me talk, you listen.
You is strong. You is clever.
Me understand your words. You say truth. Me want to reward you. Teeth necklace is best reward for our warrior. No stranger wear it. Except you. You earn! You friend! You friend with us all!

I was once a hunter, like my father and brothers who fell in battle against the creatures of the Blight. But now I decided to help the Circle of the Keepers, because only they know how to defeat it once and for all.

h: Wait here, we'll sort it out

t: Oh, so you've come to help us? Oh yeah, this is a night to remember! These vampires have overrun the entire camp!
Will stakes of aspenwood work? Ahem... Oh, it's you again. Got any questions left?
Pioneers? What? What are you doing here? I don't seem to remember you. Are you vampires?! Aaaaahh!
Ah. I see now. Please forgive me. These vampires have overrun the entire camp! That's why I've been quite a bit nervous.
h: Calm down, we are the rescue party. Uniform is worn for cover.
Tell me about the Pioneer Camp

t: Whew... I hadn't hoped to stay alive... Thanks for saving me!

This is highly unusual! The dead have come back to life, we have people from different eras... I understand that many are confused and lost right now, but we will have to govern them somehow eventually. Who will have that power? There are at least five Valirs here – me and my distant descendants...
Valir and Kania! They are bound together... For thousands of years, my family has ruled over our Empire. And they will continue to do so...

h: Do you have something for me?

t: The Light has always been with you... After hearing your call, we came to watch how the Architect continues his Path. But he stumbled upon your world and no longer poses a threat to the Light.
I'm not a liar, but I learned to lie when I had to...
Damn, this is just nonsense... Where is my swamp? What is this place? This is outrageous!

h: Do you have something for me?

t: Croak! Oh, I mean, yeah! Gotcha! Well, scoundrels, are you going to turn me back into a frog?! I was a nice little toad, but what am I now? Some stupid broad, with tits like melons. What should I do now? I didn't ask to be turned! I'll have to become a sorceress, and then... Then I'll get my revenge!

We started making forays - we'll go to the mountains and cause a ruckus among the orcs. Or we'll go to the swamps and fight all sorts of monsters... Those monsters are a lot worse than the local ones...
Can you believe that I alone drank seventeen bottles of champagne after dinner...?
But I've been saving up! Collecting them! Even went hungry on occasion! You must lend me three thousand. I need them, brothersister! At any cost!

My path is marked out for me! My parent spent his whole life in prison and he ordered the same for me... When I was little, they called me a thief, a thief's son... I've been a thief since childhood... everyone always told me, "Vaska the thief, Vaska the thief's son! Yeah? Is that right? Then that's what you get! I'm a thief! You understand: maybe I'm a thief out of spite... I'm a thief because no one ever thought to call me anything else...

The Blight is an extremely curious phenomenon. Yes, when you defeated the First Demon in the Burial Mound, the Blight was cut off from its source. And after the events... uhm... on Dane, the forces that fueled it completely disappeared. Those were the most successful years - we were able to push it back significantly. Even Glimor was freed, for example...

However, after some time it stabilized along the borders of Plagot, Forlorn Thicket, Clear Valley, and Al Rihat. Now the stain of the Blight extends from the southern borders of the capital to the northeast of the allod.

What caused it? The Glimor Council of Technomagic is still debating that question...

Ah, my old friend turned his back on me! All I wanted was to be the first to solve the mystery of Skytower, save the Great Skrakan, and deal with the Prime Demon... If I had succeeded, you would be collecting pages from Veglud's diary, not Danas's!
Playing with fire can burn you. Playing with magic can cost you your life. Do not repeat my mistakes... Great Mages do not like it when their secrets are uncovered...

h: Do you have something for me?

t: Thank goodness, you're here, mighty and fearless warriors. Our forest suffers great misfortune, a plague making all the animals mad! For the sake of a delicate summer wind and a health-giving brook, I adjure you, please, please help us! Kill the mad beasts and let the happy times return!
Hello there! How can I help you?
Give me your junk, I'll give you a Faded Seashell in return!

I would trade with you, but you don't seem to have anything I could use! For example: 10 servings of Delicate Crab Feed, 10 Crab Pills, 10 fruits of the same kind, underwear, headwear, a costume, a horse bridle, a wolf collar...

Bring me some of this stuff, I'll gladly give you Faded Seashells for it!

Perhaps you think we are savages who live here like barbarians, knowing nothing about other worlds... But you are mistaken.

Although Eidos was destroyed, we still managed to save the prototypes of creation. Everything is here, in the memory of our Trees. Each Tree in this world is only a part of the shared memory which contains information about everything that has happened.

Yes, Eden is hidden from other people's eyes, but the All-Mother secretly visits her Children who continue to fight Darkness in the outer and inner worlds. What she sees, what she hears, becomes part of the Tree's memory.

I often dive into the memory of our Tree to see other worlds. In some places, the inhabitants follow the precepts of our Creator, and in some, the darkness has already took hold of their souls. You are proud of your... "technology", but I have seen worlds where even the soil is hidden under a layer of metal and man-made stone. In their pride, the inhabitants of those worlds completely rebuilt everything that exists, perverting it. You are only at the beginning of this journey, and it is not too late to change your mind.
h: Hello, what do you do here?

t: Fine. There are twelve inner worlds. Eden is one of them. The fate of the primal world Eidos is very sad. Which world do you want to talk about?
h: I want to ask about inner worlds.

t: There's an infinite number of worlds. Each of them is fighting a battle. Which ones do you want to hear about?
h: Have you heard of any other worlds, contested by Nihaz?

t: Alright. I can share the Tree's knowledge. As I said, there's an infinite number of outer worlds. The Tree preserves only the knowledge received from messengers that get in touch with All-Mother, while she briefly travels outside Eden. Here is what I've heard about the worlds that worked up Nihaz's appetite...
h: I want to ask about the outer worlds.

t:
I... I don't... Why?!

Those were Wormfaces! Everyone who could resist went crazy one after another. Those who remained sane were simply killed... by our allies. Our allies! Arhivina killed Pierre... He won't resurrect, I can feel it. I know it! What did she do to him?!

And why?! We never did any harm to them! We didn't even know they were here...

Ugh... But oh well.

We're all for the League. Alliances are cool. As long as they aren't directed against someone.

I don't get it, why don't we all form an alliance? We're on peaceful terms with the Empire. We settled things down with demons and architects.

How about a global union, huh? PanSarnaut League? Anyway, House de Vevre wants to make love, peace, and music, not war.
h: Some other time. What can you say about the League? What's House de Vevre's attitude?

t:
Ah, it's you! The one who disrupted my plans on Umoir! I wanted to organize fights with these mighty beasts! But don't worry, I've found a way - why use Blighted mutants when I have the Ambrosia? Creatures pumped full of Ambrosia - what can be cooler than that! So fights are definitely going to happen.

Of course, I had to sweet-talk the Gray Prince, and now I owe him. But I always pay my debts. Someday my father's killers will pay for everything, just like my traitor brother. Soon Yasker will fall and the Korleone family will regain their power.
Was it easy for a little girl who lost her father to take over as boss of the mafia? What do you think?
I'm not sleeping. I'm keeping watch. We Werebears have a quick ear - should something happen, I'll be there... Now go away. I'm resting.
Can't you see? I'm a Werebear. You've never met a Werebear? I'm a village elder from Ignis. They call us Snorers.

Hey, brosis, don't you listen to these eggheads! I've just tried to poke in there, and barely got away alive! Got a full charge to my right bun, heh! Yeah, there's these turrets all around the place...
You sure can do stuff, rookie!
h: I've managed to disable all the turrets!

t: So, how's the life, heh? I'm Viper the Firm, the only protection for this whole circus.

We need to find a way to send a message to Nezeb... I'll tell you everything - about Yasker's betrayal, about Korleone, about the project from Lab-1... I wish I could get my diary back... I wrote it all down...
Hey, where is everyone? Matilde, Egor, Barbara? Where did they all go? I don't understand... Even Nubius is gone...

h: Do you have something for me?

r137040.s: Priest of the Church of Light

h: Have you seen Katerina? She has disappeared!

t: Oh, what a thunderstorm... I hope it won't cause a forest fire!

Once, we were chopping wood in the forest, and there was a hard frost. I went back to the house, and the horse was pulling a wagon of brushwood slowly up the hill. I walked, leading the horse... Then suddenly I saw a poet!

I'm an assistant troop leader. I keep an eye out on things. In fact, I'm trying to make our visitors from the League feel at home. Only by our example can we prove that the Imperial ideas are the future.

I'm Volka Krutch. A pioneer, an athlete, a drummer at school, and a future builder of our country.

I'm also an assistant troop leader. I keep an eye out on things.
Ah, all people are odd people out. Leave me a couple of kopecks for a drink...?
h: Don't try to talk me out of it. Pay what you owe the casino!

t: It's like this: they are born, they live, they die. I will die... and so will you... Why shouldn't we have a little fun?
I am actually a lady-in-waiting to the Empress of Kania! Do you even know who you are talking to?

Will we ever explore even a small part of it? My students talk about Star Paths and worlds, my colleagues – about the infinity of the astral, and I'll say this: pay attention to what's hidden right under your nose! To the moon! No, I'm not some lunatic. Everything is strictly scientific – the astral reflects reality, even if it distorts it... The chronicles do not lie either – once upon a time our world had its own satellite!
Help me with this cannon. Go on, I’ll tell you what to do.
Next we’re firing a signal rocket! We go up that hill and bang!

What do you mean? We were invited here. A whole herd of centaurs arrived from Ammer and Frontier. We are... as the elves say, a delegation! We live in the forest, hunt all kinds of animals. As for the reason you haven't met us before... Well, we're good at hiding.
h: Ancient Moon! What brings you here?

t: What? It's a Ball, there are guests, tables with food. It's not a place for rides!
h: Wow... Me and Skulnar wondered if... Could you take us for a ride?

t:
Easy! You're a funny creature.

I see that my father did some work on you. There's something in you, you know. Ideal destroyers, created by the God of Light and bred up by the God of Darkness.

Let's calm down and talk. You're not strong enough to challenge me.
h: I'll get you in the end.

t:
Don't you get it?

Maverick can open portals to other worlds. He had been looking for Eden for quite a while, until he found it. The rest was only a question of time.

For one thing, I didn't expect you to get here so fast. But you got me curious. Only two from your world got to get here before. The one you know as Sage... although I don't really understand what's so wise about this pathetic local deity. The other one... the Children call him Madman. He's got a way more interesting personality.

He told me about you and your world. If even one percent of you resemble Madman just a little, your world is a gem compared to the rest of the Universe.

You're a little like him. And I can make good use of all of you. I'll give Madman his body back. And then... no, it's too early to announce.

When we were transported to Isa, the squirrel and I ended up far away from you. We found ourselves next to the Great Tree, and I marveled at its greatness. Then we met the Heidruns, a good-natured tribe that lives in this Valley. When they learned who we were, they brought us here, and I was glad to see blossoms among the ice and snow. Ratatoskr went looking for you, and I decided to wait, because I knew your path would lead you here eventually.
h: Where have you been all this time?!

t: I'm amazed at the diversity of Sarnaut. In that I see the great gift of creativity that Sarn possessed. I know he sought to free himself by creating those who would destroy his prison. But the talent given by the All-Mother was too powerful in him, so he created something truly beautiful - against his will!
My heart mourns the loss. My world, your world... orphaned.
My heart mourns the loss. My world, your world... orphaned.

We helped the All-Mother! Should I go back to Eden and help my people in their fight against the Expedition? I'm told Rhubarb continues to fight... Or should I look for more allies? Like those Star Knights?

May the power of Life bless you! I have a message from my home world, just for you! Like a wave from a rock falling into the water, the news of a new God of Death is spreading across the worlds! This new threat, which exceeds the threat of Nihaz and the architects, has forced the gods to unite. The Divine Children of the All-Mother have realized how much is at stake. But each of them is an army of their own... Who knows, perhaps they will storm the Gates of Ganzir or even come here, to Sarnaut?

Such is the message of the Children of Light, and I have already informed the Conclave...

I'm glad we achieved our goal! I think the All-Mother knows we haven't forgotten about her. I'm sure we'll find a way to free her now. These warriors of Enod are real heroes. They will surely answer the call and come to Sarnaut to end Hirkalla and any darkness. Now we need to be patient.
h: What are your thoughts on what happened?

t: I will stay in Sarnaut. From now on, your world is connected with ours, and everything that happens in Sarnaut immediately reverberates through Eden. There are many interesting things in your world. I would like to talk to this Circle of Druids, to visit the Kingdom of Nature, to understand the beliefs of Gibberlings, Orcs and Pridens. I want to see how the appearance of the Great Trees in your world influenced you.

We don't really look alike, don't you think?

We are born from the Tree, and Sarn created the Gibberlings. But he raised them from the flesh of a Great Tree...

Perhaps, somewhere very far away, at the origins of creation, our roots might be intertwined.
h: The Gibberlings are also the children of the Ash Tree. Are you related?

t:
How I love the Ash Tree!

Just think about it: this tree grew from the seed of Eden. And each seed of the Great Tree is one of us, the Children!

Look at my head. See? It's a nut. When my time comes, the nut will be buried in the soil of Eden. And if I'm lucky, I'll sprout as a new Tree!

I wonder what was the name of the one who gave life to the Ash Tree...
Good boys... And hungry, too. Want to have a bite? Go! Gnaw, tear, feast!
These fools think a few barriers can save them from their fate... Prove them wrong. You must get to the workshop and destroy one goblin’s work. Do not shy away from... bloody measures.
I came here to ask for mercy, not justice.

Hell if I know.

Wrokag and other shamans will soon be rushing back to me. All they dream of is breaking away from the Empire. Can’t judge them on that - orcs are not built to depend on feeble humans! But what are they expecting of me? I abandoned them for so many years - well, I was dead - and they still haven’t started anything resembling a rebellion...

They’re just a herd of sheep. And I’m not going to lead it.
h: What are you going to do?

t:
It’s pretty fine here. It’s peaceful. I haven’t seen those horned guys before - where did they come from? What? An explosion in the battle of gods? Alright, tell me this some other time.

Oh... I need a drink! Do they have a tavern here?

I did eat your horse, true. But you have no idea how hungry I was! My fault, anyway. I must help you now. The name’s Savva, Savva Swallow, at your service.

Let’s visit Nikodim, he lives near here. Gather some nuts on the way, he feeds birds with it.
h: You greedy guts, why have you swallowed the horse? How am I supposed to get Firebird now?
Enter the Whirl and challenge Thalos

t:
Beyond the Whirl - is another time and unknown space...

Are you ready for a dive?
Get the quest from Cosmos to depart: Mission Infinity.
h: Enter the Whirlpool and search for Infinity

t: Hello! It's amazing to be here in the Empire, but misfortune... unites us all.

Pure luck. The condition of our ship was far from good, and we couldn't scan for stable allods. So I set up our scanner to find large anomalies, and here we are.

From the point of view of modern technomagic, your allod is just a large anomaly!
h: How did you manage to find this allod?

t:
I never thought you might be interested. I'm a sorceress, one of those that don't belong to a particular school. I take interest in multiple subjects, trying to learn a little of each, but I don't have a profound knowledge of any. That might sound like amateurism, but it comes in handy! Especially when your life is in danger.

Alchemy and technomagic have always been my favorite. I also know a lot about elemental and astral magic, and even a little about necromancy - Tritogor was no stranger to dark arts...

All of them originate from Forox. The survivors are a motley lot of ordinary peasants, warriors, and even a traveling minstrel band. I can't personally vouch for each of them, but I had a chance to meet them all in person on the ship, there are no master criminals.

The only thing I'm sure about, is they all are grateful to you for the shelter, Keeper. While we're here, they're going to serve you faithfully. After all, that's what their lives depend on.

Greetings to this Allod's keeper!

You must be the Great Mage who is holding it together? You aren't? Then... is it the meteorite ore? How curious... What an amazing place!

I was a student of Great Mage Tritogor. He's the mage that was supporting Forox since the day when Bogsha disappeared in the Misty Valley. As if one tragedy wasn't enough! Something... dark possessed my teacher. Forox almost got deserted under his rule. We were able to evacuate people, but...

You see, not so many people survived.

I beg you, the Keeper of this allod, allow us to stay here, at least for a while! I give you my word to faithfully serve you... And I can offer my services as an alchemist. All Forox science, including the secret of Embrium processing.
Thank you. My life and my knowledge are yours.
h: You and your people may stay.

t: One of each? That should do. I'll make the potion now, and you go take a walk, then come back.
h: He are the insects you asked for

t: Ready. Here you go. Quarr! I hope your friend gets well.
Quarr! What brings you here, wingless creature?

The summer is ending, but your friend is not ready to leave the nest? I know how we can fix this. Special sorcery! It's tricky! Fading Summer Spark - it hold the power of the sun! I'll give you one for a seashell or a coin.

You use its power to get a new task from Ar'ra to help you raise the parrot.

But only once a day! Can't let the young parrot overexert himself!

Do you want to see my goods?
h: How do I raise the parrot faster?

t: Tell me why I shouldn't lock you in together with other soft-skinned? There is one thing, however...

We are a single whole, a single cycle.

Test the strength of each of us and defeat us in our unity if you wish to learn this lesson.

Oh, I'm looking over my domain...

After all, I'm wherever winter is. Although winter in Sarnaut is a different matter. But there are places where I still have power. This is one of them.

Yes, I had other things to do. But I decided to drop by... Well, it's fun here. Winter is not just severe cold and frost. There are also thaws, Christmas trees, and holidays! While the nights are dark in winter, the day begins to lengthen.

My strength has been growing for some time now, so I will visit these snowy lands often.

There are not many of us left - the deities of the old era when the world was one. What happened in the last year? It was like a window was opened and something fresh came into our world... That, I do not know.
h: I've never seen you here before.
I know what you did last winter...
You lived in a cottage on a hill by the forest...

t: Hey, strangers! Ring a coin in my pannikin! Stop for a while, have a rest and enjoy a fabulous dance! Have fruit, and sweet baklava, and fresh sorbet!

Iblis and all his seytans, this goddamned pest, may his name be cursed forever, sworn on his mother's grave that not a single living soul will ever find out about our deal! It looks like he needed the note as a proof, to get away with his intent, if it is revealed!

It was I who helped one of Sultan's wife conceive. The old man swindled me and never paid the price! So I dragged Vizir into it. He's so hungry for power, that he gladly agreed to help me. See, if Sultan is in grief, he won't be able to rule, which means, all power goes into Mehmet Pasha's hands! One tiny snake in a fruit basket will bring in so much misery for Dersaadet... And revenge is so sweet!
Repetition truly is the mother of skill!
h: Remind me about carrying in the arms.

t: Repetition truly is the mother of skill!
h: Remind me about carrying in the arms.

t: Do you want to learn a trick? A girl can hop into the arms of her partner. Unless she's one of the gibberlings, of course.

Damn, I could use a beer...

In short, I’m looking for a T-shaped pipe, but the thing is... I've been looking for days! What does the letter "T" even look like? I don't know... Help me out, eh? I don't want to do anything... It should be somewhere in this part of the camp.
h: Hello. I'm here to help you search for the part.

t: We shouldn't stay here for too long, or else we will be younger than our grandchildren by the time we come back.
Hi, how can I help you?

h: Ask to prepare ship for flight

t: You’ve changed your mind? It’s okay.
Hello. Did you need something? Your face looks familiar...

Oh hello! Please take me to the central portal! We must get there unnoticed. I will follow you, sneak when you sneak, speed up when you speed up. But if we are noticed, I’m going to return to this cage. It will remain opened, but we will have to start all over again.

Alright?

What do you think... Darkness is coming, all that jazz! I can’t wait till it swallows you all!

Well, I’m helping this Darkness. Someone has to do it, yeah?

I’m selling stuff here for the infected folk like you!

Nihaz is a smart guy. He knows you won’t lift a finger unless there’s a reward tied to it! Damn collectors...

Ugh... You reek of pure spirit!

Get out of here before I drop dead!
Right, finally one of ours! Where have you been?
Do not compare peasants and nobles. We are not idle noblemen - we are hard-working people!
Only two sources of joy Jacob possessed: tending and serving his lord devotedly, and rocking his own little nephew to rest. Then one day Jacob went mad for a spell.
There is something I don't understand... So our natural cousins, Spiritwoods and Kikimoras, are like pets to you? Like some kind of squirrels? How come?

Peace is always a weird political situation. When you’re at war, everything is clear and simple. You know who you don’t trust. You know what you want to achieve and how. You have rigid moral restrictions, and your people have vivid goals. While armistice...

As my experience shows, there isn’t such thing as peace. There’s only uncertainty. You’re either part of the Empire, or you’re against the Empire. A simple world design.

Peace is always a weird political situation. When you’re at war, everything is clear and simple. You know who you don’t trust. You know what you want to achieve and how. You have rigid moral restrictions, and your people have vivid goals. While armistice...

As my experience shows, there isn’t such thing as peace. There’s only uncertainty. You’re either part of the Empire, or you’re against the Empire. A simple world design.
So they’ve got brave? Well, this is for the best... Maybe. But don’t think I’ll forget this.
Is there anything important? If no, please excuse me - I’m busy.
These items are available to everyone.
What accessories would you like to buy?
These items are available to everyone. We have lots of those!

Look who's coming to visit! The bane of evil, defender of the poor and destitute, etc.... Except on the Battleground, a good suit of armor and a sharp blade will do you more good than any of those meaningless titles. Every square inch of ground has to be earned in pitched battle! But if you can distinguish yourself, I can sell you amazing items, available only to those participating in the Battleground.
Want some free advice? If you enjoy frequent trips to Purgatory you should come aboard! If not, you should wait a little while.

Hm. I think you might be ready to go to Dragon Ring now. You should still be on your guard while you're there, though - it's a very dangerous place.
I've heard that the leaders of the Empire and the League have begun to take interest in our activities there. You may want to check with your superiors to see if they need any help before you go. But if you already know what you're doing, then welcome aboard!
There is great power in the blood. Nefer Ur and Tep are two traitors... I will have them thrown into the deepest pits of Hickut...

h: Do you have something for me?

r184370.s: Head of the Briya noble family

h: What do you know of Nefer Ur and his role in overthrowing the last Despot?

t: Who told you that darkness is bad? This is where the most exciting adventures are lurking!

Oh, look who comes around! You look like you've just been dragged out of the sand. I always knew that one day we would be returned to life, but I never thought it would be so... pathetic. You know, when I was alive, I could afford myself any luxury, and even the most deviant pleasures. But now, I have to rely on you to even remember my ancient "exploits". Here's the flash drive with my recordings – there's even a couple of stories about the games I played with Peraah's concubines. I hope you don't mind to get a little "frisky" while learning of my past!
h: Tell me something of the time when Nefer Ur ousted the Despot?

t: When we press the launch button, it's not just the flight that's going to start, but a whole new chapter in the history of Sarnaut. Get ready – the Cosmos is waiting!

One of the reasons I am here is that the allod must be defended against a probable enemy. I've heard that you have already encountered Tep's Cultists. Have you noticed the tactics they've been using? Small bands infiltrating through unregistered portals. Why is that? Because our shores are securely defended by the Empire's Astral fleet! And the League, may they get a cannonball up their hole, has volunteered to help with patrolling. Sure, we agreed to that, but we're not allowing them to get anywhere close...

Yes?! Yes?! What is it? With all respect, I don't give a damn about all that Cultist intrigue. But I want to learn more about the research complex as much as you do. I'm sure there's plenty of valuable things to explore!

If only I wasn't distracted that often! Everyone needs to solve their problems all the time. Someone broke a precious device, someone needs to ask about Mechanoids. And so many stupid questions! Thousands of them! Like yours, for instance. And it happens every ten minutes. There's no way I can get concentrated! And I thought it was noisy back in the ZIT Headquarters. Comparing to this buzzing hive, it was as quiet as a cemetery!

Tell those one-celled Prowls that I will burn their fur regardless of who they send to ask their questions!
h: Ask about the "Gates" project and its connection to Tep Cultists.

t: Mysterious mechanisms that survived a generation of humans independently? There is something interesting in this middle of nowhere, after all.
Where would you like to go?
Yeah, he's got us all fed up here! You lure him here, and I'll transport him wherever you say!
h: Will you help me ferry Ahbu right to the cyber club?

t: Huh? All that I can see is termites and your queries. Wait a second. I think I can help you. If you help me first, of course. Scientist's word!
h: I had a vision. Or rather, a note from my friend. What I'm trying to say is, have you seen a sneaky gibberling around here?

t: Alright, good. Who was the second in the hierarchy?
Wonderful! Who was the leader of the Hive?
h: I've found all notes. Now I'm prepared to tell you about the Hive hierarchy.

r186779.s: Employée senior de la ferme d'hybrides

t:
Of course we have some spare clothes and armor.

They are good for starters, but we suggest you find something better in the short term.

If you lose these clothes or wear them out - come back again, and we will provide you with a replacement.
h: Ask for a starter's equipment set

t:
Oh, we are living in a grim age. First Demons, now these monsters...

Sometimes you just want to turn your face to the wall.

Greetings! My people have a special relationship with history. It might be a distant past you, but for us it's still relevant.

So on behalf of Zayan and the teachers of our university on Ammer, I solemnly present you with your honorary degree.
You've been a part of so many historical events, and you even know Zayan, so you can't possibly be completely ignorant in this field!

Needless to say, future generations will read about your deeds. But I still hope that your natural curiosity and desire to discover the next secrets of this world will continue to push you forward!
History is a great science. There's so much we still don't know about the world.

I've seen all of it, is there any more? Decadence, corruption, decay... Only the most useless, witless and reckless of the Zem nation remain there − those who could not find a more useful thing to do.

Sar-Iram is a completely unbearable city... that jumble of metal where the clattering and creaking never cease. Nefer Ur must've lost his mind if he wants all of the Arisen to congregate there... We'll be standing on top of each other before long.

All right, so be it. This journey might benefit me − more so since I want to take stock of the uncontrolled Undead from the southern part of that allod.
h: We still need to go to Xadagan!

t: It was very needless of you to interrupt my research! I was on the verge of another discovery!

It was our screenwriter's idea. They needed a Kanian for the Memories movie. So they invited me, the native Imperial. Weird, huh? But I was so convincing that even the director loved me. Given that he and the screenwriter don't agree so often. So...
h: How did you get to the Dream Factory?

t:
I act in accordance with screenplay. Sometimes I just act weird. Most often, I'm a Kanian, but I can also be an Aoidoi, a Priden, or an Orc. But I'll pass on playing an Elf.

Unless it's a girl-elf... never mind me. It's personal!
An actor. Sometimes I can be a tech consult. Bad-tempered. Married. Unstable.
What? Huh? Yes! Oh, right, I did lose one!
h: Haven't you lost a wallet by chance?

t: Just you try and take it from me!
h: Give me the wallet! It's not yours!

r541958.s: Gardien en chef de la Plante mortelle

quests: Scientific Problem: New Tests for Ahbu

t: These newbs will now know what real skill looks like!
Thank you! I'll get a dose now and go at the targets again!
Thank you! I'll get a dose now and go at the targets again!

Hello, my melancholic friends! If you are looking for a style reflecting the storm within your souls, then you have come to the right place! We have everything here, from form-fitting T-shirts with profound inscriptions to vivid accessories that highlight your personality. Allow your inner world to shine through!

After all the night-long experiments, I've found that after reanimating the roots of swamp plants through necromancy and integrating them into the cyborg's prosthetics, this cyborg starts expressing emotions through grapevines.

They are capable of entangling everything around them and whispering poetic verses of the youth now gone. But unfortunately, the vines turned out too sensitive to compliments, and they cannot perform tasks unless they receive group praise.
h: What results have you managed to get?

t: Greetings, colleague! I'm studying the effects of plants on cybernetic flesh.

h: What results have you managed to get this week?

t: Are they ever going to leave me alone...
Well, let's go, I'll take you there!
Well, let's go, I'll take you there!
Hey, welcome to my lair, make yourself at home... if you find room. Choose a place in the shadow. Suslanger is scorching hot. I even had to take my armored hoodie.

Well, the cameraman needed a break and the culture department needed to execute the plan. So they've been looking and asking around and they saw my works. One of them was a storyboard for a made-up movie. And it suddenly occurred to them, what if they draw each frame and then shoot it? That's something new for the Motion Stories. So we started working together. And then then cameraman returned. We're working together now.
h: How did you get to the Dream Factory?

t:
It's a nickname I got after the Opening of the Eyes procedure.

Those who hired me have never heard of the Arisen before. They noticed that I was skinny, and one of the clerks was, like, "He's as slender as a skeleton! He's the king of skeletons!" My feelings were hurt but only just a little. After all, he was merely stating the obvious. That's how I got the nickname Skel.

It's also way handier to sign pictures using one short nickname. I decided to keep it. I got used to it anyway.
h: What's with the name? It doesn't sound like any other Zem name.

t: [Skel shows you his posters. Some of them are funny. On one of them you see Catherina and an Eclipse engineer. On another, a mage fiercely fights a violent Demon Kamikaze.]

Mananimation is a recent invention. It's a motion story, where everything is drawn. Actors only record voice-overs for their characters. You might have seen a couple of trailers. The audience loved them! So we decided to keep it up.
h: Your position sounds fancy. Never heard of anything like this before.

t:
I'm a mananimator. I'm drawing fun posters, leaflets, and sketches. I even publish my own magazine. It's called "Skel's corner." You can take a look if you like.

I'm also working for the Dream Factory. They wanted to try the new format. People call it "mananimation" or "mananimated cartoons."
I'm trading cartridges! Got a unique cartridge with 9999 games in one! Just imagine: 9999 games at once!

r181914.s: Sermonneur de l'Église de la Triade

t: Greetings, my dear friends! In our factory, we have excellent machines for work and entertainment. They are both reliable and powerful - perfect for any kind of task! Come visit me and pick your own ideal helper!

r240462.s: Priest of the Church of Light

t: Eh, I'll go to town soon... Now that I know there won't be a thunderstorm for two weeks...

If you want to look like an Irene dandy, come here!

I've read Adam de Pluie and decided to become an economist. I learned to assess how a state gets rich, and what it subsists on, and why it doesn't need gold when this product exists!

quests: Congratulate 10 Warriors of the maximum level and return to Zabava…

t: Greetings! I'm glad to see you and the other heroes! You've helped many people, me included, and we're not going to forget this. I believe we'll meet again some day - in the restored house of the Junes.

Greetings! I'm glad to see you and the other heroes! It's been fifteen years since your first exploits. You've helped many people, me included, and we're not going to forget this. I believe we'll meet again some day - in the restored house of the Junes.

Yes, we'll reclaim our homeland and revive our people, and neither Sarn nor Nihaz will stop us.

Perhaps we'll make our own contribution to the future of Sarnaut. Remember - you will always be welcome in our new homeland.
They are pandering to those astral creatures! We’ve fought them for years and we’ll keep doing it! And you should decide what side you’re on!
h: Ask not to attack the Demonologists.

t: It's her! Have you defeated her? Unbelievable! Let me help you transport her to the Outpost. You can't do it on your own. Let me know when you're ready to go.
h: The local monster turned out to be Annette. Here she is, on a chain...

t: Forward, ! It’s not every day you drag an elf on a chain!

What a mess. The elves, the undead... and the air is full mushroom spores, it's hard to breathe.

Achoo...!

It's hard to say what it was... But it's not the first incident of this kind on Imperial projects. We ourselves have encountered some examples of... negligence. It's funny, we were swamped with forms and reports, but this bureaucracy still can't beat their traditional irresponsibility and solidarity. Faulty components, unnecessary excursions... Even during the accident there were unauthorized persons at the site... There was some woman running back and forth. It's a mess!
h: What do you think caused it?

t: Ah, hello! It's good to see you again!

Hah! I knew something would happen here! I insisted that we should build it on Umoir! We have plenty of space there.

But no, they decided to do it here. Well, the result speaks for itself. I'm not sure what happened, but someone messed up...

Ambrosia... I can say one thing for sure - it's not a new type of Blight, even if there are similarities. Further research is needed.
h: Hello! I was sent here to learn more about the incident...

t:
You have a terrible memory. Like a bird!

We first met on the Eclipse when you stormed the ship! We fought bravely, though it didn't end well for me...

Then you and I dealt with the problems in Foul Dale, and you naively believed that I was behind the rebellion among the nobles... Yes, you'd make a poor detective. Too much stupidity and willingness to believe everything people say.  Of course it was Svetlana, Prince Dakkar's wife!

When I was done with Foul Dale, I came here. The mistress has high hopes for this project, and I can't let her down!
h: Remind me again - who are you?

t:
You again, !

Well, since we're celebrating your anniversary, I won't be too nitpicky. You can live for now.

You again, !

What did you do to our ship? Yes, yes, after going to Nihaz's Citadel! Demons wrecked the place, it took us months to fix everything. How can you trust heroes after that...

How did the assault on Nihaz's Citadel go? Did you succeed? I knew it.

Well, since we're celebrating your anniversary, I won't be too nitpicky. You can live for now.

Oh Tensess, you're here again. And you brought some strange guests with you. Who are they?

Who is that winged damsel? Is that a six-legged cat? A giant pigeon? And the crocodile... Am I hallucinating...?

Anyway, these are some weird creatures, while the orcs and goblins... Goblins should be scrubbing down the hold! Instead of strutting around in tailcoats... They will make a mess - it's all they ever do.

Last time we had elves, a cultured bunch...

We should arrange a celebration in Darkblood Citadel... But Eclipse will do, I suppose.

But what can I tell you? You already know everything. Yes, it's your celebration, .

I'm already writing about your deeds in my Chronicles. Yes, there are many pages about you. In that regard, you are on a par with people like Danas, Iglez, Ath-Zak. , the hero of Sarnaut. How does that sound?

But remember: history is often a comedy, and even more often, a tragedy. Your story is not finished yet, and how it ends depends on you.

Like the last time, Catherina acts as a hospitable hostess, ...

But I'm glad we have this opportunity to meet again and discuss everything. The last year presented quite a few challenges.

Unity is a fragile thing, and soon our alliances will be tested. It's not even about the League and Empire, though I'm pleased that Aidenus and Yasker are trying to find a common ground.

A difficult time awaits the League and Empire, because both are torn apart by internal conflicts.

And Cosmos whose actions give cause for concern. No, I don't believe he is Nihaz's puppet, but he's been making a lot of enemies by his uncompromising choices.

Let's discuss this after the Anniversary... For now, let's celebrate!

Ah, ...

What should I tell you this time... First of all, you should have talked to me before opening the Gates to some other world. I'm afraid Catherina and Klavdia acted too rashly...

I'm not sure we need to rush things in the current situation. I spoke with some of the guests, and they agree that the risks are great. And some are only concerned about future profits...

But since the decision has already been made, I will help you. First of all, we need Skulnar. Perhaps we'll find out what Elleken really meant.

When will you stop falling into every trap set for you? Really, bringing a goddess to a world that served as a prison for a god? Releasing an ancient orc, freeing his soul when everyone was being resurrected? Spilling everything you'd been through to a monk who was totally not suspicious?

But alright, everyone makes mistakes, and the Great Mages who destroyed the world have no business lecturing you...

I will continue to follow your adventures... It seems that your connection to this mysterious Luck is what makes them so interesting.

But what can I tell you? You already know everything. Yes, it's your celebration, .

I'm already writing about your deeds in my Chronicles. Yes, there are many pages written about you.

But remember: history is often a comedy, and even more often, a tragedy. Your story is not finished yet, and how it ends depends on you.

I don't like this idea... But since I can't stop you, I'll do my best to help you and not let you destroy the world right now.

I swore to repay my old debt, and I will. Nobody knows how to work with flows of pure energy better than I do, because as soon as you open up a Seal, it will flood the whole place with energy. I will distribute it between our sorceresses so that they can prevent either of the gods from winning, and also protect us. And you... Cut, chop, burn - do whatever it takes to stop the gods from prevailing over each other!

Interfering with gods' business is dangerous, bid it's even more dangerous to sit idle when the fate of the world is at stake! After the Seals are destroyed, the biggest battle in the history of Sarnaut will begin! I will not ask whether you are ready for that - nobody is. Just let me know when we start.
h: Start the Battle of the Gods

t: There is no place for mortals in the battle of gods. All that we can do is pray. If in several minutes the world does not disappear in a fire vortex and does not turn into solid stone, than we did the right thing.
h: Open up the Seals and hope that the Architect and Sarn will just destroy each other

t: Well... We won't have another try!
This is a wise decision. You better stay away from that battle and let luck decide our fate.
I'm speechless. This is... unbelievable. Please give me some peace and quiet to reflect upon what has happened so that I can write this down without missing any details.

No idea. The more I think of it, the scarier it seems.

But this is exactly what our enemy wants - to scare us. We have to keep looking for a way.
h: What do you think about the war with Nihaz?

t: This place gives us many possibilities... And I’m not sure whether I want to use them.
We're here. We can't move forward yet. I hope it'll change soon.

Like any young race, Aoidoi are young and reckless in their desires. But they are wiser than many... And they are correct to think that something needs to be done with a source of power like the Well. Magic does not like to be unused. If it is not directed somewhere, it could case...

Well, we know what can happen. Look at our world.
It’s a good allod. The air is very clear here. I feel a thousand years younger...

The orc was right when he said prophecy was not a sentence. Did you know the Chronicles of Sarnaut contain stories of prophecies that never came to be? Of prophets that were laughed at? We’re threatened with a doomsday every year.

But don’t worry, I’m not disregarding your words. I talked to Ademar. I heard him out. I have a plan. In case of emergency. It’s too early to talk about it, but when the time comes, I’ll take care of it.
h: Zayan, what can you tell me about the prophecy?

t: In these troubled times, it’s important to maintain balance in the world.

Yes, this is extremely interesting.

As a Historian, I am in awe of your discoveries. But as a person who has a certain experience, I am horrified by what you have done...
h: Tell them what you have managed to learn in Eden

t:
I guess neither Catherina nor this goddess will listen to my advice.

However, if you are interested in my opinion, then I would suggest finding a compromise. What kind? That's for you to find out. You know, I've known you for a long time, and I believe that while you've made some mistakes, you have plenty of experience. You will find a solution.

This Expedition was originally a gamble, and we have yet to deal with the consequences.

The first time I saw this rhinoceros, when it was spinning around, flaring its nostrils, and flints were flying from under its hooves, something I could not understand took place within my soul; and since that time I have been weary of everything. I looked at my father's best rhinos with disdain, I have been ashamed to be seen on them, and yearning has taken possession of me. In my anguish I spent whole days on the cliffs, and, every minute, my thoughts kept turning to that rhino with his graceful gait and his sleek back, straight as an arrow. With his keen, bright eyes he has looked into mine as if about to speak...

Thank goodness, help is here! But how did you... Ah, it doesn't matter!

Welcome to New Bay, the most thriving Aoidos colony in the whole Archipelago. At least it used to be so, before Demons started falling from the sky a couple of hours ago!

No, these Demons are fine. They're with us. Is it hard to tell them from each other? Well, let's say, if it's not trying to incinerate you, it's friendly.

The levitation network, that used to connect the two parts of the city, went dead instantly. In this part of the colony, there aren't many warriors - mainly craftsmen and poets like myself. We cannot call for help. Neither can we find out what is going on in the other parts of the city.

I also heard that some kind of a monster is hiding in the water.
Oh, is the old countess really dead? What a pity, she was resurrected only recently... Well, Lisa is as good a housewife as she was...
Are you sure you want to bind to this location?
Hello there! How can I help you?
They say black shadows wander here at night... What a nonsense.
She said I knew? Of course I do! I’m a senior lab worker! But it is her job to hand out passwords to newbies like you! Tell her that!
What an idiocy! The second part is “Power”. And now leave me alone.
h: Ask for the second part of the password
